name: auth-failure
description: A token both header forms reject. The script tries the Bearer spelling, retries the same request once with the raw token, and when that is also refused it must end with a printed diagnostic and zero assets rather than aborting or spinning: exactly two requests, the fallback log line, and the final error line carrying the 401. namespaced_ids is skipped for the reason recorded in happy: the id is the bare Stairwell asset number with no tenant scope (no asset is emitted here, but the skip keeps the reason with the scenario).

log_contains: stairwell: Bearer authorization rejected (401), retrying with the raw token form
